name: Dip Dock
summary: A phone tab bar with a dip that flows to the tab you tap, carrying a glossy bubble icon
about: A bottom tab bar for phone screens where the selected tab sits in a smooth dip with a glossy bubble floating above it. When you change tabs the dip flows along the bar on a spring, the bubble sinks, stretches and sheds droplets like liquid, the icons it passes duck out of the way, and it pops back up with a ripple. Good for mobile apps and phone-sized web apps.
how: Tap or click a tab, or use the Left and Right arrow keys.
The dip slides toward the new tab on a spring, flattening while it moves fast.
The bubble sinks and stretches like a drop, drips a few droplets and swaps to the new icon halfway along; icons under it duck as it passes.
It settles into the new dip with a ripple and a little icon spin, the label appears and the screen cards pop in one by one.
